Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target CHEMBL4105860 in Homo sapiens assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4105860 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
